elemente.text: Look at the title and headings first.
Activate what you already know about the topic.
Predict what the text might be about.
Underline key words and signal words.
Use pictures or captions to support understanding.
Guess unknown words from the context.
Ask who, what, when and where while reading.
Skip one difficult word if it is not important for the main idea.
Summarise the text in your own words.
Check whether your prediction was right.
Find the sentence that gives the main message.
Compare your answers with a partner.
